mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4, reducing itraconazole plasma concentrations and antifungal efficacy, while itraconazole may inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism, complicating seizure control.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor antifungal efficacy closely and consider alternative azole or antiepileptic agent with less enzyme induction.
